en-US.title: If you have cabbage at home, try this! 👍! A simple and delicious meal! 😃! Cabbage Dishes
en-US.description:
If you have cabbage at home, try this! 👍! A simple and delicious meal is complete! 😃! Cabbage Dish

Recipe:
250g cabbage
50g carrots
Boiling water
Water
10g green onions
1/6 tsp pepper
1/4 tsp salt
1/2 tsp seasoning powder
2 tbsp frying powder
3 eggs
Cooking oil
50g mozzarella cheese
Fry until golden brown on one side.
Fry the other side as well.
Fry until golden brown and crispy on both sides.

snippet.title: 남은 떡국떡가 집에 있다면 이렇게 꼭 드셔 보세요👍! 잔뜩 만들어도 남아나질 않아요😃! 쫀득쫀득 간단하고 색다른 떡국떡 2가지
snippet.description:
남은 떡국떡가 집에 있다면 이렇게 꼭 드셔 보세요👍! 잔뜩 만들어도 남아나질 않아요😃! 쫀득쫀득 간단하고 색다른 떡국떡 2가지

얇게 썬 떡 레시피 1:
얇게 썬 떡 230g
2-3분간 삶기
물
간장 1.5큰술
굴소스 1큰술
참기름 1큰술
마늘 1쪽
후추 1/6작은술
고추소스 1큰술
식용유 1큰술
양파 50g
고추 10g
깨 1큰술
파 15g

얇게 썬 떡 레시피 1:
얇게 썬 떡 150g
물
25-30분간 불려주세요
대파 10g
고추 30g
계란 3개
후추 1/6작은술
양념가루 1/3작은술
소금 1/5작은술
25-30분 후
식용유 1큰술
중불에서 볶아주세요
떡이 부드러워지기 시작하면 골고루 익도록 뒤집어주세요.
표면이 살짝 노릇해지거나 투명해질 때까지 볶아주세요.
뚜껑을 덮고 계란이 익을 때까지 1-2분 더 볶아주세요.
토마토 케첩
모짜렐라 치즈 60g
뚜껑을 덮고 1-2분간 치즈가 녹도록 해주세요.
말린 대파

en-US.description:
If you have cucumbers at home, try this! 👍! A nutritious and delicious meal is complete! 😃! Cucumber Recipe

Eat cucumbers and apples like this! 😃! It's said to help eliminate waste and help with obesity, a diet recipe!
If you have cucumbers at home, try this! 👍! You won't have any leftovers even if you make a lot! Cucumber Recipe
If you have cucumbers at home, try this! 👍! A simple and delicious meal is complete! Cucumber Recipe

Recipe:
200g cucumbers
3 eggs
15g green onions
2/3 tsp seasoning powder
1/6 tsp pepper
1/4 tsp salt
3 tbsp frying powder
1 tbsp cooking oil
Cover and cook until golden brown on one side.
Flip and cook the other side.
Fry until golden brown and crispy on both sides. #cooking #deliciouscooking #easycooking #KunKitchen #simplecooking #cookingforsingleperson

en-US.description:
Instead of rice, try this cabbage and egg dish 👍! A hearty, protein-packed cabbage and egg dish with eggplant 😃! Cabbage Dish

Recipe:
350g cabbage
1 tbsp cooking oil
50g onion
15g red pepper
20g shiitake mushrooms
1/6 tsp pepper
2/3 tsp seasoning powder
1/2 tsp red pepper powder
1 tbsp soy sauce
2 eggs
70g mozzarella cheese
2 tbsp batter
Cook in an air fryer at 180°C for 10-12 minutes

en-US.description:
If you have cabbage at home, try this! 👍! How to make breakfast with cabbage and eggs 😃! It's filling and filling.

Recipe:
300g cabbage
2/3 tbsp salt
Add water after 10 minutes
1 egg yolk
1/6 tbsp pepper
1/2 tbsp red pepper powder
3 tbsp batter
20g green onions
1 tbsp cooking oil
Fry until golden brown on one side. Flip and cook the other side. Fry until golden brown and crispy on both sides.
Chili sauce
